next_step: Closed-lost. Capture learnings: hyperscaler procurement win; re-engage in 6-12 months if consolidation or multi-cloud requirement emerges.
closed_lost_reason: Customer elected to standardize on hyperscaler-managed endpoints (Azure OpenAI + Azure ML) to consolidate tooling, leverage existing committed spend and native AD/KMS integrations.
notes:
Summary: Lost to hyperscaler managed endpoints (Azure). Customer ran a 4-week POC with Redwood Dedicated; heavy emphasis on latency for chat and embeddings, and on KMS-managed keys. Decision path and timeline:
- 2024-09-12: Intro demo (Ethan P.). Good fit on features; customer interested in dedicated GPU pools and VPC private control plane.
- 2024-10-02: Architecture deep-dive with SE (Maya C.) - discussed batching, quantization, prefix caching.
- 2024-11-05: POC kickoff (small pilot): integrated sample ingestion pipeline, 10k-doc embedding test.
- 2024-11-20: Security questionnaire submitted; asked for SOC2, iso27001 evidence, KMS integration patterns.
- 2024-12-18: Exec brief; procurement signaled need for single-vendor consolidation across cloud estate.
- 2025-01-10: Final security review - network team requested managed service that sits within existing cloud tenancy (Azure AD + Managed Keys).
- 2025-02-05: Purchase decision: chose Azure-managed endpoints tied to existing committed Azure spend.
Why we lost:
- Native integrations: Azure offered out-of-the-box AD/KMS/monitoring integration which reduced friction for their infra team.
- Commercial: discounts on committed spend and consolidation incentives from their cloud reseller.
- Operational preference: SREs wanted a managed endpoint to reduce operational burden; internal roadmap pushed toward single-cloud vendor.
- Organizational: internal champion (Head of ML Ops) changed roles during procurement; new stakeholders favored vendor consolidation.
Open items / follow-ups (internal):
- Capture POC benchmarks and cost delta vs Azure for future competitive plays.
- Add a short one-pager comparing Redwood Dedicated + Private vs Hyperscaler managed endpoints for procurement teams (focus: multi-cloud fallback, portability).
- Flag account for 6-12 month re-engagement cadence if cloud consolidation strategy shifts.
Quoted customer notes: "We have to standardize on one cloud for infra simplicity — Azure made it an easy business decision." + "The KMS and AD tie-in was the clincher."
Supporting artifacts: Security FAQ and POC logs in Drive, fireflies for the key calls, INF/SEC tickets for the KMS integration questions.
customer_feedback_snippet: "Lower integration work, single bill, and committed discount made the hyperscaler route easier to sell internally. Not a reflection on product fit — more procurement-driven."
